behaviors.description: If the wampa takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
behaviors.descriptionWithLinks: If the wampa takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
behaviors.name: Fear of Fire

behaviors.description: The wampa has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
behaviors.descriptionWithLinks: The wampa has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
behaviors.name: Keen Smell

behaviors.description: The wampa has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.
behaviors.descriptionWithLinks: The wampa has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.
behaviors.name: Snow Camouflage

behaviors.description: The wampa makes two attacks, one with its claw and one with its bite.
behaviors.descriptionWithLinks: The wampa makes two attacks, one with its claw and one with its bite.
behaviors.name: Multiattack

behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) kinetic damage.
behaviors.descriptionWithLinks: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) kinetic damage.
behaviors.name: Claw

behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) kinetic damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Snow Wampa can't bite another target.

behaviors.name: Bite

name: Snow Wampa
sectionText: Wampas are semi-sentient predators with humanoid proportions that stand up to 12 feet tall. While they all share characteristics in common, there are three variations of wampa that are distinct based on their native planet.
